title: Beyond Performance: Quantifying and Mitigating Label Bias in LLMs
reasoning: The paper investigates the technical phenomenon of label bias in Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on the development of metrics (RSD, BiasScore) and a calibration method (LOOC). While it utilizes tasks categorized under 'Ethics Classification' as a small subset (6 out of 279) of its evaluation benchmark, its primary objective is the quantification and mitigation of statistical label preferences rather than the evaluation of religious, spiritual, or moral systems.
